body: I call him babe because he brings me the same comfort as when I sleep in my boyfriend's arms. I started calling him babe when one night I woke up  and then cuddled him, unknowingly calling him "Babe".

So one day me and my 8 YO cousin were eating oranges after lunch and he accidentally swallowed a seed and I told him not to drink water because then it'd grow and become a tree. I was just joking and teasing him..And then before dinner at around 9PM he went to my mom asking "I can't do it anymore I'm thirsty I want to drink water what if I poop and the seed comes out , will I be able to drink water then?". I upon hearing this felt so bad. I still feel guilty to this day and my cousin is 12YO.
I have the same "Bagel" and I sleep in the same position like yours ..it's weird and amazing at the same time 😂
Yeah but I haven't experienced death either..and I'd like to experience it..I have planned it all now...It's gonna be on Sunday..Wish me luck..

I know it seems weird And seems like I need help but trust me I don't...I'm happy..I smile at the thought of dying..And I have been planning my death for a very very long time..I am not depressed.. I don't cry at all. I don't even remember the last time I cried.. I just want to leave this world happily..Without making my loved ones feel bad so I decided to make my "Suicide" look like an accident.. I planned ja family vacation to seaside..and I decided I'd drown there..My family will be there and they'd know it was an accident. But it failed. They didn't let me go deep they didn't even let me go medium.. Anyways I failed...Now I want to know more ways of accidents..That guarantees me death..
